curated.instructions: omr/instructions/8081-1-1.pdf, omr/instructions/8081-1-2.pdf and omr/instructions/8081-1-3.pdf (books 1-3, the one model; the alternate model was a download only)

functions.does: The black gear on the roof steers the front wheels: its upright axle comes down behind the seats to a knob gear, which turns a long axle running forward under the seats to a small gear that slides the steering rack across the front axle, and steering links push the front hubs.
functions.source: book: book 1 steps 11-13 (long axle, knob gear and the 8-tooth gear, the hand on step 13 turning it), book 2 step 30 (the roof gear on its upright axle); how it's worked inferred, as the book draws no arrow for it

functions.does: Rolling the car turns the V4 engine: the rear wheels drive the differential, a shaft with a universal joint carries the drive forward under the seats, and its gear turns the crankshaft through an idler gear, so the four yellow pistons pump up and down.
functions.source: book: book 1 steps 1-10 and pages 19-21 (differential, universal joint and drive shaft), book 1 steps 22-24 (engine and crankshaft gears)

functions.does: The rear differential lets the two rear wheels turn at different speeds round corners.
functions.source: book: book 1 pages 19-21 (the differential with its 28-tooth bevel gear in the rear axle housing)
functions.note: with the engine held still, turning one rear wheel turns the other the opposite way

functions.does: The bonnet tilts up on a hinge at the windscreen, showing the engine.
functions.source: book: book 3 step 18 (the red arrow lifts the bonnet)

functions.does: The two front doors open, each swinging out on a hinge at its front edge.
functions.source: book: book 3 steps 9-12 (doors fitted on their hinge pins); inferred: that they're meant to open
functions.note: each door opens on its own; the left one's panel is p478 64392, the right one's p510 64682

functions.does: The tailgate at the back swings up on a hinge at the roof.
functions.source: book: book 3 step 5 (red arrows swing the rear panel up and round)
functions.note: inferred which parts make up the tailgate

functions.does: The front wheels have independent suspension: each hub rides between an upper and a lower suspension arm, and moves up and down, steering as it goes; the rear axle sits on two shock absorbers.
functions.source: book: book 1 front axle sub-steps 1-11 on pages 34-36 (suspension arms and hubs), book 1 step 21 (rear shock absorbers); inferred: that it's meant to move and how far
functions.note: unsure how the front shock absorber p209 76537 and the rear axle are hung; to be checked against the book

functions.does: The shock absorbers' springs hold the car up and spring back.
functions.skip: springs only push back under force

functions.does: The small steering wheel in the cab turns on its own; it doesn't steer.
functions.source: inferred: book 2 step 16 fits it on its own short axle, and the steering is worked from the roof
